name: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Costa Rica 2024–2027
owner: Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones
description: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy of Costa Rica 2024–2027 (published October 29, 2024). National artificial intelligence strategy of Costa Rica issued by MICITT for 2024–2027, aligned with UNESCO's Recommendation on the Ethics of AI and OECD AI Principles.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (micitt.go.cr) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación, Tecnología y Telecomunicaciones (micitt.go.cr).
